description: This Go source file implements a fake OpenAPI server for testing purposes within the Kubernetes client-go project. It includes definitions for a mock server, a custom HTTP mux, and functions to load OpenAPI specifications from JSON files, register handlers, and serve HTTP requests.

classes.name: FakeOpenAPIServer
classes.description: Struct representing a mock OpenAPI server with an embedded HTTP server, served documents, and request counters.

classes.name: testMux
classes.description: Custom HTTP request multiplexer used for handling OpenAPI requests in the fake server.

methods.name: NewFakeOpenAPIV3Server
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new fake OpenAPI V3 server, loading specifications from a given directory.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Registers a handler for a specific path in the testMux.

methods.name: HandlePrefix
methods.description: Registers a handler for a path prefix in the testMux.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, dispatching to registered handlers or returning 404.
